items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 July 2026 5:06am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 17 July 2026 at 4:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing overnight.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the south of Iceland, extending a ridge across the British Isles.


##Wind##

Mainly north or northwest 2 to 4, but variable 3 or less in places throughout. Increasing 5 or 6 in the northwest through the North Channel to central areas overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate in the west later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 to 5, but 5 or 6 in northwestern waters, becoming north or northwest 3 to 5 in all waters later on Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
